WF-06 Workflow

  • Xoá activity “[report edit permission] Edit the DOCX draft in ONLYOFFICE”
  • Đổi nhãn: Finish saves, validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF → Validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF
  • Đổi hình: activity activity “Finish saves, validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF” → system activity
  • Đổi lane: Lab head → System
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: system activity “Create draft report” → notification “✉ Notify lab head” → system activity “Create draft report” → system activity “Validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF”
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: activity “[report edit permission] Edit the DOCX draft in ONLYOFFICE” → activity “Finish saves, validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF” → system activity “Validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF” → notification “✉ Notify lab head”
  • Xoá activity “Finish saves, validate data, reserve number and prepare PDF” → activity “Review report”
  • Đổi đầu cạnh: notification “✉ Notify lab head” → activity “[report edit permission] Edit the DOCX draft in ONLYOFFICE” → notification “✉ Notify lab head” → activity “Review report”
